tools.name: list_elements
tools.description: Elements (minerals, vitamins, protein) that have a LabelTruth page, with the number of products tracked in the whole catalogue.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: Chemical forms of one element that have at least one priced product in the region, in alphabetical order. No prices: forms are not ranked against each other.

tools.name: cheapest_in_form
tools.description: Products of one chemical form ranked by euro per 1000 mg of the element, cheapest first, at the shop price when last checked. Only ranked products are listed (limit 1-10, default 5).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product by its LabelTruth slug: shelf price, store, and euro per 1000 mg of the element when the product is ranked (otherwise the reason it is not).
